do_not_use_when: The store already exists and only needs binning: use amplitude-predictions.
A plain cross-section lookup suffices: use cross-section.

examples.phrase: Integrate a process with per-point helicity amplitudes into a resumable store.

use_when: Build a resumable Gram store of per-point helicity amplitudes from an amplitude program.
A later coupling, mass or width scan must be reweighted exactly from one weighted integration.
